title: wire-layer
description: manifests/wire-layer.json — the files licensed Apache-2.0 while the rest of the repository is AGPL-3.0-or-later (operator ruling 2026-09-09, D19 item 6). bin/test/wire-layer-licence.test.mjs asserts every entry exists and is marked; a file not listed is AGPL.

licenseText.description: Repo-relative path of the licence text the marker points at.

marker.description: How the licence is asserted in place: a LICENSE file path for a directory, spdx-header for a source file, manifest-only for a data file that cannot carry a header.

excludes.description: Sub-paths that keep their own licences.
